description: Fog reduced visibility to 50 m on multiple EVA days. One EVA was attempted then cancelled mid-preparation.
response: The Commander authorised an out-of-sim, unsuited EVA when fog partially cleared, accepting reduced fidelity to protect scientific objectives.
lesson: Define visibility thresholds for EVA go/no-go in advance. Have a clear protocol for out-of-sim EVA authorisation when conditions preclude simulation but objectives are at risk.
